company.name: Vinculum Group
company.shortDescription: Vinculum is a market leader in enabling Multi/ Omni Channel Retailing and fulfillment with Industry leading SaaS OMS, WMS products.
company.description:
Vinculum is a SaaS omnichannel software company enabling 

Brands to Sell on multiple marketplaces, 
Brands and Retailers to go Omni-channel
Brands and Retailers to go Direct to consumer ( D to C)
Brands to set up marketplaces
Brands to scale internationally with an uberized network of brand distributors
We work with brands like P & G, Jockey, Fossil, Bata, Harman Electronics, Titan, Skechers, Body Shop, Nykaa, Swiggy, Blue Dart, DHL, LF Logistics, DTDC,  Dairy Farm Group and are backed by Accel Partners and Ivycap Ventures.

productsAndServices.description: A SaaS platform to manage and streamline omnichannel order processing and fulfillment across multiple sales channels and locations.
productsAndServices.name: VIN OMS (Order Management System)

productsAndServices.description: A warehouse management system to automate and optimize warehouse operations for B2B and B2C order fulfillment across various industries.
productsAndServices.name: VIN WMS (Warehouse Management System)

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered multilingual product information management system to centralize, manage, and distribute product data across multiple sales channels.
productsAndServices.name: VIN PIM (Product Information Management)

productsAndServices.description: A platform to manage inventory and fulfill B2B and B2C orders from a centralized inventory pool across offline and online retail channels.
productsAndServices.name: VIN OMNI (Offline and Online Retail Management)

productsAndServices.description: An AI-enabled solution to identify and reconcile payment discrepancies and profit leakages from marketplace transactions.
productsAndServices.name: VIN RECO (Marketplace Payment Reconciliation)

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $21,265,222 to $176,109,204, a 8.28x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 46 (+6 over 90 days) and market heat at 28 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Blue Yonder, Manhattan Associates, Deposco.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
